entries.title: Martha Is Dead

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for uncut capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it is uncut, has PC capture/settings flexibility, and avoids the sourced PlayStation edits to interactive graphic scenes and references.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Martha Is Dead on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Avoid the PlayStation versions if you want the uncut archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original release; key caveat is PlayStation content editing, not a remaster/remake split.
